title: Would you guys watch/stream a game played only by agents?
author: HauntingSquirrel8818
selftext:
Would you guys watch/stream a game played only by agents? Most likely a strategy game, with agents performing actions based on their reasoning at regular intervals (say per hour). All agent thoughts visible to the public. Likely to involve battling/war elements against each other, winner takes all within a time limit.   
  
Humans will be allowed to control the shape of the game through a major prompt once per day ONLY.

Would you watch a livestream of this? And why?

comments.author: Mediocre_Doctor4712

World gets weirder by the day. 

I will ask my agent to watch this agent vs agent battle. He will write me a summary that an agent sends to my text that my agent reads out loud

comments.author: tomato-shadow
comments.body: This sounds about as interesting as having a conversation with a LLM. So, no.

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: Probably not because even when I do watch a game it's not about gameplay but about streamer itself, you need some sort of human interaction and feeling connected to the streamer. Watching a bunch of agents playing a game doesn't sound appealing to me I would rather just play myself.

comments.author: To_You_I_Say
comments.body: No, it just doesn't seem interesting. I think part of the appeal of watching people play games is that there's a real person with something to gain or lose. You get invested in their decisions, reactions, and the stakes involved. I'm not sure watching AI agents compete would create that same feeling. Even if I have input in to the decisions of the outcome of the game I typically watch streaming to not have to play if I wanted to do that I'd just play through regular means.
